name: Sai
phase_notes: Body recomposition at maintenance (started 2026-11-22). Returning from ~16-week layoff; at ~20% body fat, so muscle regain toward the 2026-04-09 baseline happens at maintenance while fat comes off. Goal: lose belly/face fat while progressively overloading. Keep bodyweight flat (weekly average within ±0.5kg of 79.9kg); protein floor 175g/day. Judge progress by lifts, waist measurement and photos, not the scale. Switch to 'lean-bulk' (~2800 kcal) once body fat is ~15% AND lifts meet or exceed the 2026-04-09 baseline.
